items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-09-08
items.q: A fellow by the name of Bonte, he got shot. And when we marched there... I said, I was about setting up the club.

ctx.x: Well, having some of the clubs been going on for a long time, too?

Yeah, sure. The club has been going on a long time, too. Mostly in fact, they tell me that's how clubs were formed. Because when I formed the White Rose, Lost Set Roses, White Roses, that's how we started. A fellow by the name of Bonte, he got shot. And when we marched there, and when we got in there, I said, I was about setting up the club. Who all want to set up the club, raise their hand up. It started right there. Got about nine and ten of them. Then I set up a quorum up, see. They say, you be the president.…
Well, the club, did the club pay for the funeral?
